name: Night Shift at Kuroda Robotics
description: Kuroda Robotics builds the soldiers that will guard the ice, and the night shift is asleep. Cross the assembly hall, the sleeping bay and the control floor, then climb to the roof where the plant's admin password waits. Every tier splits two ways: a short guarded route for the soldier along the assembly line, and a longer, quiet one for the hacker over the gantries and through the vents. Hack the lasers and security doors, ride the moving platforms, wear the briefcase past the turret and step through the teleport.
